summary: Unpinned off-registry git dependency resolved at install time
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `git+https://github.com/whiskeysockets/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity constraint. On `npm install`, the dependency is fetched from whatever the repository's HEAD currently serves and any lifecycle scripts within the fetched tree execute in the installer's environment. Because the source is outside the npm registry and unpinned, the code executed on install is controlled by whoever controls that repository at install time rather than by a versioned, hash-checked registry artifact. The `ping`/`GET` pattern flagged in lib/Utils/generics.js lines 184/228/384 is a connectivity/keepalive helper inside the library's runtime code and is not itself an install-time exfiltration path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
